pr_body:
Use wait.PollWithContext to ensure all queued operations are processed before concluding the test, preventing intermittent failures caused by early test completion under heavy concurrency.

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
This PR fixes a flaking test in `k8s.io/client-go/tools/cache/controller_test.go`. It uses `wait.PollWithContext` to wait for all queued operations to be processed before concluding the test, ensuring the test doesn’t end prematurely under heavy concurrency.

Let me know if you agree and I’ll push the change.

review_comments:
Removing this `Lock` has the effect that the test no longer works as originally intended. It was already there before I added `WaitGroup` waiting.

I didn't write it, so I can't say whether the controller logic indeed ensures that all goroutines have stopped once `controller.RunWithContext` returns.

Given that the original test didn't actually check for leaked goroutines (see the TODO that I replaced with the comment about leak checking in main with goleak), it is quite possible that there is a flaw in the controller logic that hasn't been detected earlier.
so , most possible the test is right and there is some subtle leak in the controller
Thanks for catching that, and sorry again for the confusion. I'll close this PR and open a new issue to look into the controller leak that's showing up.
anyway, was a good exercise, so we have more clear this test, I think it was a positive outcome overall
